facts.text: Stetson undergraduate students must complete 24 cultural credits from approved campus events such as lectures, concerts, and plays to graduate.

sources.title: Cultural Credit - Stetson University
sources.quote: In addition to completing 32 course units, students join Stetson University's intellectual and creative life outside the classroom by earning 24 cultural credits as a graduation requirement from approved events at Stetson.
